4.why: EVO2 were bought for line 4; 2 of its 4 turns carry a low-floor guarantee on every trip; 9 EVO2 are active (320–328). The newest, delivered in 2026, were picked.

2.why: VarioLF plus 314 and 315 are registered as used on line 2 only; the guaranteed turn and one other get them, the third turn VarioLFR.S 253.

1.why: Kept with one tram (user decision 28 Sep 2026): the fixed T3M.3 pair 236 + 237, one of the five pairs the register lists as coupled sets. The shift runs before 16:00 (5 pairs at 15:00) are not in the peak and are not modelled.

3.why: Morning-only line, no guarantee: three solo T3M.3 in the standard livery.

notes.Tatra T3M.3: placeholder art: the classic Most T3 body in the right paint; the T3M.3 dash and doors are not drawn yet

pak.couplings: Different types never couple. T3M.3 and VarioLFR.S couple with the same type; EVO2 can run as two coupled sets.

line_notes.1: Shift line for the Chempark (Orlen Unipetrol) works, weekdays about 06:30–07:40 and 13:00–16:00. At 15:00 five coupled T3M.3 pairs run it; at 16:00 one tram is left. As decided, it is modelled as that one tram shuttling Dopravní podnik – Chempark every 60 min (designed frequency, the timetable's last minutes).
line_notes.2: Town line inside Most every 15 min. One of the three turns is timetabled with a low-floor guarantee on every trip. The VarioLF plus cars 314 and 315 are registered as used on line 2 only.
line_notes.3: Morning-only line, about 05:00–06:45, with no afternoon trips. It is shown at the morning peak (06:00), following the rule for lines without afternoon service.
line_notes.4: The main Most – Litvínov line, every 15 min, cut back to Záluží, Chempark while the Litvínov track is modernised. Two of the four turns carry a low-floor guarantee on every trip.

network_state: Since 1 Mar 2026 (23:15) the section Záluží, Chemopetrol – Litvínov, Citadela is run by replacement buses, and lines 1, 3 and 4 turn at the Záluží, Chempark loop. Night line 40 is all buses and is left out. The trams keep their timetable times.
A full-day closure for track maintenance at Sportovní hala. Over long ago; not in the model.
fit_why: Fits use the shared runfit rule around 16:00 (core 15:30–16:30); the morning-only line 3 uses 05:30–06:30. Line 1's schedule is designed (see schedule_override).
branches_why: Every DPmML line runs between two termini at the peak, so each is one Simutrans line.
shared_pools: None. Each line keeps its own trams at the peak.
type_lengths_source: EVO2 21,650 mm without couplers (cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/EVO2); EVO1 body 15.1 m (Pragoimex); T3 family and Vario single cars 15.1 m.
peak_rule: User ruling of 28 Sep 2026: a short working gets its own Simutrans line only with at least 3 trips in 15:00–17:59, no depot at either end and at least one departure in the 16:00–16:59 hour; otherwise it is listed as not modelled, with no values.

1.why: Designed frequency, user decision 28 Sep 2026: keep line 1 with the one tram it has at 16:00. One round trip Dopravní podnik – Chempark – Dopravní podnik takes 20 + 20 min running plus layovers, so one tram can hold every 60 min. The minutes are the timetable's last shift trips: 15:08 from Dopravní podnik and 15:42 from Chempark.

The other four fixed T3M.3 pairs of line 1's register roster. Only one tram runs at 16:00 (user decision 28 Sep 2026), so they are not needed. Shown per the roster coverage and spares rule (user, 29 Sep 2026), not counted.
